Email Notification List, with Manager and Specific Users selected
Access Profiles, with an email distribution list access profile added
Identity State, with Inactive (long-term) selected
questions.answer: Email Notification List, with Manager and Specific Users selected
questions.explanation: The Email Notification List can notify the manager, all SailPoint admins or specific email addresses. The other tabs control accounts, access and identity state.

questions.stem: An administrator wants to change the wording of the notification message that is sent when an identity moves to a new lifecycle state. What should be edited?
choices: The identity profile's description field
The Lifecycle State Change email template
The lifecycle state's technical name
The source's provisioning policy
questions.answer: The Lifecycle State Change email template
questions.explanation: Lifecycle state notifications use the Lifecycle State Change email template, which can be customized. The technical name must stay matched to cloudLifecycleState values.

questions.stem: An identity in an Inactive (long-term) state needs its corrected identity values pushed to its target accounts one more time. How can an administrator do this?
choices: Move the identity to another identity profile and then back again
Turn on Remove all access for the identity's lifecycle state
Raise the source's account deletion threshold for one day
Run Synchronize Attributes for the identity in the Identity List
questions.answer: Run Synchronize Attributes for the identity in the Identity List
questions.explanation: Admins can manually start attribute sync for an Inactive (long-term) identity with Synchronize Attributes, or through the single-identity attribute sync API.

questions.stem: A lifecycle state's notification list includes All SailPoint Admins. Who receives the email?
choices: Users with org admin access
Every source owner in the tenant
Every identity in the profile
Only the identity's own manager
questions.answer: Users with org admin access
questions.explanation: All SailPoint Admins notifies users who have org admin access. Manager and Specific Users are separate choices on the notification list.

questions.stem: An administrator is setting up a new Contractor Ended lifecycle state. Put the steps in order.
items: Select Create Lifecycle State in the identity profile and enter the name
Configure the account settings and access profiles for the state
Choose the identity state that identities in the state will have
Select Apply Changes to process identities
questions.explanation: The state is created and configured, then enabled and saved. Apply Changes starts identity processing so identities move into the state and its provisioning runs.

questions.stem: Match each lifecycle state status to its cause.

pairs.match: The attribute is unmapped or the value is null
The value matches no state in the identity's profile

pairs.item: Does Not Match Technical Name Case
pairs.match: The value differs from a technical name only in letter case
An administrator set the state by hand

targets_extra: The state's provisioning retries ran out
questions.explanation: The three statuses describe a missing, unknown or wrongly cased cloudLifecycleState value, and Manual marks a state set by an admin. Failed retries are reported in provisioning activity, not as a lifecycle status.

questions.topic: Account Actions and Remove All Access
questions.stem: An administrator is configuring a lifecycle state for leavers. Which TWO actions can the lifecycle state itself perform?
choices: Disable the identity's accounts on selected sources
Remove the identity's access with Remove all access
Launch a certification campaign for the identity's manager
Change the identity profile's priority value
Delete the identity's authoritative HR record
answers: Disable the identity's accounts on selected sources
Remove the identity's access with Remove all access
questions.explanation: Lifecycle states can enable, disable or delete source accounts, remove access and grant access profiles. They do not start campaigns, change profile priority or edit the HR system.
